evidence: The Secretary of Commerce shall initiate an investigation under section 232 to determine the effects on national security of imports of processed critical minerals and their derivative products.

summary: Directs HHS and other officials to lower drug costs via Medicare negotiation guidance, a high-cost drug payment model, health center insulin and epinephrine access, and faster importation approval.
evidence: the Secretary of Health and Human Services (Secretary), consistent with sections 1191 to 1198 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1320f-1320f-7) and other applicable law, shall propose and seek comment on guidance for the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program for initial price applicability year 2028

summary: Revokes Executive Orders 12072 and 13006 on siting federal facilities in central business districts and historic properties, and directs GSA to begin amending its space management regulations to conform.
evidence: Executive Order 12072 is hereby revoked.

summary: Directs Commerce to review and reduce fishing regulations, develop an America First Seafood Strategy and a seafood trade strategy with USTR, and review marine national monuments for commercial fishing.

summary: Directs the Attorney General and DHS Secretary to publish a list of sanctuary jurisdictions, and agencies to identify federal funds to those jurisdictions for suspension or termination, with legal enforcement steps.
evidence: Within 30 days of the date of this order, the Attorney General, in coordination with the Secretary of Homeland Security, shall publish a list of States and local jurisdictions that obstruct the enforcement of Federal immigration laws (sanctuary jurisdictions).

summary: Requires agency heads to designate a senior appointee to review funding announcements and discretionary grants, and directs OMB to revise grant guidance to allow termination for convenience.

summary: Continues the listed federal advisory committees until September 30, 2027, and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for them to the designated agency heads.
evidence: Each advisory committee listed below is continued until September 30, 2027.

summary: Reduces the additional duty on products of the PRC under Executive Order 14195 from 20 percent to 10 percent, effective November 10, 2025, and amends the HTSUS accordingly.
evidence: All articles that are subject to the additional ad valorem rate of duty of 20 percent under Executive Order 14195, as amended, shall instead be subject to an additional ad valorem rate of duty of 10 percent.

evidence: The Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States shall be modified as provided in Annex II to this order. summary: Directs State and Treasury to report within 30 days on designating Muslim Brotherhood chapters, including in Lebanon, Jordan and Egypt, as terrorist organizations, then act within 45 days of the report.
evidence: Within 30 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of State and the Secretary of the Treasury, after consultation with the Attorney General and the Director of National Intelligence, shall submit a joint report to the President, through the Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs, concerning the designation of any Muslim Brotherhood chapters or other subdivisions, including those in Lebanon, Jordan, and Egypt

summary: Establishes the Genesis Mission, a national AI-for-science effort, and directs the Energy Secretary to build and run the American Science and Security Platform and to identify at least 20 science challenges.
evidence: There is hereby established the Genesis Mission (Mission), a national effort to accelerate the application of AI for transformative scientific discovery focused on pressing national challenges.

summary: Directs the Attorney General and FTC Chairman to each establish a Food Supply Chain Security Task Force to investigate anti-competitive behavior and foreign control in food supply chains, and to brief Congress.
evidence: The Attorney General and the Chairman of the Federal Trade Commission shall each establish a Food Supply Chain Security Task Force within the Department of Justice and the Federal Trade Commission, respectively, that will take all necessary and appropriate actions to investigate food-related industries within their established areas of expertise

summary: Directs the Attorney General to set up an AI Litigation Task Force to challenge State AI laws, and directs Commerce, FCC, and FTC actions on State AI laws, including limits on BEAD funding for States.
evidence: Within 30 days of the date of this order, the Attorney General shall establish an AI Litigation Task Force (Task Force) whose sole responsibility shall be to challenge State AI laws inconsistent with the policy set forth in section 2 of this order

summary: Directs the SEC to review and consider revising rules on proxy advisors and shareholder proposals, the FTC to investigate proxy advisor practices, and the Labor Secretary to revise ERISA fiduciary guidance.
evidence: The Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) shall review all rules, regulations, guidance, bulletins, and memoranda relating to proxy advisors.

summary: Designates illicit fentanyl and its core precursor chemicals as weapons of mass destruction and directs agencies to pursue prosecutions, financial actions, and Defense and Homeland Security measures.
evidence: I hereby designate illicit fentanyl and its core precursor chemicals as Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD).

summary: Closes executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty on December 24 and 26, 2025, while letting agency heads keep certain offices open and staff on duty for national security or public need.
evidence: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government shall be closed and their employees excused from duty on Wednesday, December 24, 2025, and Friday, December 26, 2025, the day before and the day following Christmas Day, respectively.

summary: Directs the Secretary of War to identify underperforming defense contractors that made buy-backs or distributions, and to bar such payouts in future contracts during underperformance.
evidence: Within 30 days of the date of this order, and on a continuing basis thereafter, the Secretary of War (Secretary) shall identify any defense contractors for critical weapons, supplies, and equipment that are underperforming on their contracts, ... and that have, during the period of underperformance or insufficient prioritization, investment, or production speed, engaged in any stock buy-back or corporate distribution.

summary: Declares a national emergency and bars attachment or other judicial process against Venezuelan oil revenue funds held in Treasury accounts, directing Treasury to hold them as Venezuela's property and assert immunity.
evidence: Unless licensed or otherwise authorized pursuant to this order, any attachment, judgment, decree, lien, execution, garnishment, or other judicial process is prohibited, and shall be deemed null and void, with respect to the Foreign Government Deposit Funds.

summary: Establishes a second three-member emergency board, effective January 16, 2026, to investigate Long Island Rail Road labor disputes; it must report on the most reasonable final offer after offers are submitted.
evidence: There is established, effective 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on January 16, 2026, a Board composed of a chair and two other members, all of whom shall be appointed by the President to investigate and report on these disputes.

summary: Designates the Board of Peace as a public international organization entitled to the privileges, exemptions, and immunities provided by the International Organizations Immunities Act.
evidence: I hereby designate the Board of Peace as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities provided by the International Organizations Immunities Act.

evidence: The Secretary of Homeland Security (Secretary), acting through the Administrator of the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), and the Administrator of the Small Business Administration (SBA) shall each consider promulgating regulations to advance the policies of this order.

evidence: The Federal Emergency Management Agency Review Council, created by Executive Order 14180 of January 24, 2025 (Council to Assess the Federal Emergency Management Agency), is continued until March 25, 2026.

summary: Establishes the White House Great American Recovery Initiative, co-chaired by the HHS Secretary and a Senior Advisor, to coordinate federal addiction treatment and recovery efforts and advise agencies.
evidence: There is hereby established the White House Great American Recovery Initiative (Initiative) co-chaired by the Secretary of Health and Human Services and the Senior Advisor for Addiction Recovery.

summary: Places the positions in its Appendix in Schedule Policy/Career, amends Civil Service Rules and two prior orders to implement it, and directs agencies to set aside bonus pools for these employees.
evidence: The positions set forth in the Appendix to this order are hereby placed in Schedule Policy/Career of the excepted service.

summary: Directs the Homeland Security Secretary to tighten importer-of-record rules (bonding, assets, disclosures, good standing, vetting, limits on foreign importers) and to strengthen penalties, disclosures and disposal of noncompliant imports.
evidence: Within 180 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of Homeland Security (Secretary) shall, pursuant to 19 U.S.C. 66, 1484, 1498, 1623, 1624, and 4320, and any other applicable law, take steps to revise importer eligibility regulations, guidance, and policies consistent with the policy of this order.

summary: Directs agencies to transition to post-quantum cryptography; OMB guidance must require high value assets and high impact systems to use it for key establishment by 2030 and signatures by 2031.
evidence: Within 90 days of the date of this order, the Director of OMB shall, in consultation with the Secretary of Homeland Security through the Director of CISA and the National Cyber Director, ... issue guidance requiring each agency to

summary: Directs an update of the National Quantum Strategy and establishes the QC-ADDS Effort to develop a quantum computer, with actions on quantum sensing, supply chains, workforce and security.
evidence: There is hereby established the Quantum Computer for Application Development and Discovery Science (QC-ADDS) Effort, which shall be coordinated by the APST.

summary: Directs EPA to prioritize registering alternatives to older active ingredients and review pre-harvest desiccation uses; directs USDA to maximize Regenerative Pilot Program funding.
evidence: The Administrator of the EPA (Administrator) shall prioritize registration actions related to substances that can be used as alternatives to older active ingredients

summary: Ends most 10 U.S.C. 4872(c)(1) waivers for covered materials after Jan. 1, 2027 unless a mitigation plan is accepted, and directs War Department supply chain mapping rules and domestic source qualification.
evidence: On January 1, 2027, the Secretary of War (Secretary) and the Secretaries of the military departments shall cease to issue waivers under 10 U.S.C. 4872(c)(1) for the acquisition of covered materials under 10 U.S.C. 4872, except as provided in subsection (b) of this section.

summary: Directs the Interior Secretary, through the NPS, to install temporary signage and exhibits near the National Museum of American History citing the Report's findings; tasks officials to use available authorities on the Smithsonian.
evidence: The Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Director of the National Park Service (NPS) and in coordination with the Assistant to the President for Domestic Policy, shall install temporary signage along the NPS-maintained sisdewalks and walkways used by the public to access the Museum, informing visitors of the findings of the Report and of the policy set forth in section 1 of this order.

summary: Establishes the President's Military Spouse Commission, chaired by the Secretary of War's spouse, to advise the President on military spouse and family policies, with a report each fiscal year and a 2-year term.
evidence: There is hereby established the President's Military Spouse Commission (Commission).

summary: Prohibits agencies from issuing or accepting documents recognizing United States citizenship for persons when neither parent is a citizen and either is an alien enemy or foreign government employee.
evidence: no executive department or agency shall issue documents recognizing United States citizenship to, or accept documents issued by State, local, or other governments or authorities purporting to recognize United States citizenship regarding, persons when neither parent of that person is a citizen and any of the following applies

summary: Directs the Secretaries of State and Homeland Security to act against birth tourism on nonimmigrant visas, including denying or revoking visas and entry, and delegates INA section 215(a) authority to them.
evidence: The Secretary of State and the Secretary of Homeland Security shall take such actions and update any rules, policies, operational guidance, or other guidance as necessary to effectuate the policy set forth in this order.

summary: Declares childhood vaccine recommendations in three categories, directs HHS to present vaccine plans in 90 days, and directs the Attorney General to pursue legal actions on State exemption laws.
evidence: it is hereby declared that the United States recognizes Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations informed by the three distinct categories of childhood immunization recommendations identified in the scientific assessment, as specified below

summary: Declares a national emergency over foreign supply of bulk-power system electric equipment and prohibits foreign-produced equipment transactions that the Energy Secretary determines pose undue risk.
evidence: find that the situation with respect to the foreign supply of bulk-power system electric equipment constitutes an unusual and extraordinary threat, which has its source in whole or substantial part outside the United States, to the national security, foreign policy, and economy of the United States and hereby declare a national emergency with respect to that threat.

summary: Directs the Interior Secretary to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America" within 30 days and update the GNIS, and directs the Board on Geographic Names to guide federal references to the new name.
evidence:
Within 30 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of the Interior (Secretary) shall, in coordination with the Board on Geographic Names and consistent with 43 U.S.C. 364 through 364f, take all appropriate actions

to rename as "Lake America" the body of water currently named as Lake Ontario

summary: Establishes a Presidential Commission, chaired by the NASA Administrator, to report within 120 days on proposals for a NASA-led United States Space Academy, including governance, curriculum and service obligations.
evidence: There is hereby established the Presidential Commission on the United States Space Academy (Commission). The Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) shall serve as Chair of the Commission.

summary: Directs the Agriculture Secretary to expand Packers and Stockyards Act enforcement and to widen interstate market access for State-inspected meat, including a new guaranteed loan program for small beef processors.
evidence: The Secretary of Agriculture (Secretary) shall, consistent with the Act, and all other applicable law: (i) prioritize and expand investigations into potential violations of the Act by packers and other covered entities

summary: Directs a 90-day review of regulations affecting ranchers, a delisting determination for gray and Mexican wolves, and a review of authority for mandatory beef country-of-origin labeling.
evidence: Within 90 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of the Interior, the United States Trade Representative, the Commissioner of Food and Drugs, and the Administrator of the Small Business Administration shall submit to the President a report that assesses all executive department and agency (agency) regulations, guidance, and other agency policies affecting ranchers

summary: Requires the Secretaries of War and Veterans Affairs to set up ongoing sharing of military personnel and treatment records within 180 days and update the Transition Assistance Program.
evidence: The Secretary of War and the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall: ... within 180 days of the date of this order, establish updated information technology systems and policy guidance and memoranda to ensure, between the Department of War and the Department of Veterans Affairs, the permanent, prospective, and ongoing sharing of all Official Military Personnel Files and Service Treatment Records

summary: Amends EO 13603 to add the Secretary of the Interior alongside the Secretary of Energy in Defense Production Act energy delegations, each acting independently, and routes energy disputes to the National Energy Dominance Council.
evidence: Section 201(a)(2) of Executive Order 13603 is hereby amended by striking "the Secretary of Energy with respect to all forms of energy" and inserting, in lieu thereof, the following: "the Secretary of the Interior and the Secretary of Energy with respect to all forms of energy under their purview, each of whom may exercise such delegated authority independently of the other;".

summary: Revokes Executive Order 13508 on Chesapeake Bay restoration, directs agencies to redirect Bay funding to direct water quality projects, and tasks EPA with working with jurisdictions to encourage repeal of stormwater fees.
evidence: Executive Order 13508 is hereby revoked.

summary: Directs Interior to allow hunting in Castle Mountains and Craters of the Moon national monuments and directs agencies to propose changes expanding hunting and fishing access on Federal lands.
evidence: Within 90 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of the Interior is directed to allow for the hunting of species that are not subject to 16 U.S.C. 1533 within Castle Mountains National Monument, ... and within Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve

summary: Directs Commerce and NOAA to modernize recreational fishing data collection, including mobile reporting, and directs Interior to set up an offshore Reef-in-Place Program within 60 days.
evidence: the Secretary, acting through the Administrator of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), shall to the extent feasible and consistent with applicable law, take appropriate action, including through rulemaking pursuant to 16 U.S.C. 1851 and 1855(d), where necessary, to modernize Federal data collection infrastructure.

summary: Directs State, Labor and Homeland Security to consult Commerce, Education and SBA on H-1B filings and to weigh employer layoffs when considering H-1B applications, petitions and visas.
evidence: the Secretary of State, the Secretary of Labor, and the Secretary of Homeland Security shall take into account in any labor condition application, petition, visa, and entry of aliens entering or attempting to enter the United States as H-1B nonimmigrants to perform services in a specialty occupation whether the employer sponsor directly or indirectly engaged in layoffs within the previous year or plans future layoffs that negatively affect the employment of similarly situated United States workers.

summary: Directs the GSA Administrator to establish America.gov as a single online entry point for covered federal services, using Login.gov for authentication, and requires agencies to integrate their covered services.
evidence: The Administrator of General Services, in coordination with the Administrator of the National Design Studio and the Director of OMB, shall: (a) establish and operate America.gov as the single point of entry for Americans to access covered services online; and (b) take such steps as are necessary to integrate Login.gov with America.gov, including using Login.gov as the authentication service for America.gov.

summary: Directs agencies to run a DC campaign to cut invasive mosquitoes 90% and ticks 50% by 2028. Also orders an EPA regulatory framework for new control technologies and HHS and USDA research prizes.
evidence: Within 60 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, and the Administrator of General Services, in consultation with the Secretary of Health and Human Services, shall develop and implement a campaign across DC to, by 2028, reduce the Asian tiger mosquito, Egyptian mosquito, and other invasive mosquito populations, as appropriate, by 90 percent and reduce the tick population by 50 percent

summary: Requires executive agencies to use "Super Intelligence" and "SI" in place of "Artificial Intelligence" and "AI" in non-statutory documents. Directs the APST to propose a legislative definition within 60 days.
evidence: To the maximum extent permitted by law, executive departments and agencies (agencies) shall use "Super Intelligence" and "SI" in place of "Artificial Intelligence" and "AI" in official correspondence, public communications, websites, reports, policy documents, and other non-statutory documents within the executive branch.

summary: Directs the Treasury Secretary to determine within 5 days whether to defer diesel excise tax payments through December 31, 2026, and to have the IRS announce penalty relief for dyed diesel use.
evidence: Within 5 days of the date of this order, the Secretary, in consultation with the Secretary of War, as appropriate, shall determine whether relief is authorized under 26 U.S.C. 7508A, including whether a qualifying event has occurred and which taxpayers have been affected by that event.

summary: Sets increased duties on Russian goods and goods from certain other countries, waives those duties and listed sanctions provisions under the Graham Act, and delegates the Act's authorities.
evidence: Pursuant to section 115(a) of the Graham Act, I hereby waive the application of any duties provided for in sections 112 and 113 of the Graham Act or this order.

summary: Directs HHS and NIH to establish a Women's Health Division within 90 days, creates a White House Women's Health Task Force, and revokes Executive Order 14120 and a 2023 women's health memorandum.
evidence: The Secretary of Health and Human Services, acting through the Director of the National Institutes of Health (NIH), shall establish a Women's Health Division within an appropriate institute or center within 90 days.
